name: ESPRESSO BLEND - GRAVITONS
description:
The Espresso blend is a Dark roast, igniting a symphony of flavors that will awaken your senses. Nestled at elevations between 1250 and 1375 MASL, these estates provide the perfect canvas for our blend. The Arabica beans undergo a meticulous washing process, while the Robusta beans are naturally processed, adding to the blend's complexity. In every cup of our Espresso Blend, you'll discover the robust notes of Cocoa, the earthy essence that grounds your senses, and a bittersweet finish that lingers on your palate. Brew it your way – whether you're seeking the intense satisfaction of Espresso, the rich fullness of French Press, the classic charm of Moka Pot, or the tradition of South Indian Filter, this blend is your versatile companion.

name: MASTER BLEND - LUMINA
description:

These exceptional estates, nestled between 1300 to 1375 MASL, yield some of the best coffee in the country. In every cup of the Master Blend, you'll find the subtle notes of Dark Chocolate, the comforting embrace of roasted nuts, and delicate hints of tropical fruits. This blend is versatile in brewing methods, equally delightful whether prepared as Espresso for intensity, French Press for a full-bodied experience, Moka Pot for classic charm, or South Indian Filter for a touch of tradition.
